Hrishikesh Mohile: In Project Data Orbit, I recommend we publish data only after freshness, ownership, quality, and cost gates pass. Rationale: This addresses how to make high-volume ETL observable, replayable, and trustworthy from a management perspective. Constraint: The design must remain testable, observable, least-privilege, and reversible. Outcome: A synthetic 18-terabyte replay completed with zero unexplained variance.
